name.full: Scopture: Where physical engineering projects take shape before execution

description.short: Work on engineering projects in Scopture with Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: Ask Copilot to list available cloud drawings, summarize drawing context and open issues, review project decisions, or make a requested update. Example prompt: “List the open issues in a Scopture drawing I can access.” In order to use this app, you need to have an active Scopture account and access to the relevant cloud drawing. This remote connector does not access local .duc files; use Scopture desktop or CLI for local files. Cloud Python execution requires an eligible paid plan in the drawing’s organization. Sign in or create an account (new accounts are created automatically on first sign-in): https://site.scopture.com/login. Get Scopture: https://site.scopture.com/download. Get started: https://site.scopture.com/docs. Help: https://site.scopture.com/support/faq. Contact support: https://site.scopture.com/support.

agentConnectors.description: Use Scopture in Microsoft 365 Copilot to inspect accessible cloud drawings and project records, review issues and decisions, and make requested updates. Access is limited by your Scopture account and project permissions. Local .duc files and cloud Python execution have the requirements described in the app listing.
